title: The silent crisis on our plates

title: London’s Ultra Low Emission Zone cleaned up the city’s air. Then children’s lungs got bigger

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: But now, after five years of the ULEZ, those children’s lungs have improved, according to a major five-year study recently published in the Lancet Public Health journal.

evidence_level.evidence: The study tracked the lung development of more than 3,400 children between the ages of 6 and 9, in both London and a comparison site of Luton, another city in England with a similar mix of air pollutants but no low emissions or “clean air zone.”

benefit_distribution.evidence: The share of Londin children with clinically impaired lung function also fell significantly, from 14%, or one in 7, before the ULEZ, to 9%, or one in 11.

change_durability.evidence: It’s an initiative that has reduced toxic air pollution levels and spurred drivers to adopt cleaner vehicles.

human_thriving_analysis.dominant_subject: London's Ultra Low Emission Zone improving children's lung growth

title: De schokkende voordelen van minder luchtvervuiling: een voorbeeld uit Griekenland

human_wellbeing_impact.evidence: het aantal winterse ziekenhuisopnames wegens hartproblemen bij de belangrijkste ziekenhuizen in de regio met 22 tot 42 procent terug

evidence_level.evidence: Tussen 2011 en 2021 daalde de hoeveelheid zwaveldioxide in de winter met meer dan 90 procent. Ook de concentratie fijnstof nam af. Tegelijkertijd liep het aantal winterse ziekenhuisopnames wegens hartproblemen bij de belangrijkste ziekenhuizen in de regio met 22 tot 42 procent terug.

change_durability.evidence: Mijnen gingen dicht, centrales werden gesloten en de luchtvervuiling nam sterk af.

title: Unifesp identifica resíduo compatível com sangue no antigo DOI-Codi/SP

social_cohesion_impact.evidence: A pesquisa integra um projeto interinstitucional coordenado por pesquisadores da Unifesp, da Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) e da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), com participação da UFSC e da USP.

justice_rights_impact.evidence: Os resultados obtidos em uma antiga enfermaria e em salas de interrogatório levaram à identificação de resíduos hemáticos.

evidence_level.evidence: Em uma das amostras, coletada em uma antiga sala de interrogatório, a sala 7, um teste confirmatório apresentou resultado positivo para sangue humano.

benefit_distribution.evidence: A pesquisa integra um projeto interinstitucional coordenado por pesquisadores da Unifesp, da Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) e da Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais (UFMG), com participação da UFSC e da USP.

change_durability.evidence: A primeira etapa do projeto de pesquisa, realizada em 2022, utilizou radar de penetração no solo e escaneamento tridimensional do complexo.
